facts: Acme Robotics is a warehouse automation company founded in 2019.
The company was founded in Austin, Texas by Maria Lopez and Tom Reed.
Acme Robotics robots pick up to 1,200 items per hour with 99.7% accuracy.
The company has been SOC 2 Type II certified since March 2023.
Acme Robotics has offices in Austin, Rotterdam, and Osaka.
Customers of Acme Robotics include Ford and DHL.
